description: Mechanics-15 3D calibration: the full run's cell and model settings on ONE maze (M10, all four mechanics) to measure per-query input/output tokens and cost before launching run_config.mechanics_15_3d.json.
_note_no_conditions: No conditions key => single (default) cell built from experiment_config overlay. Do NOT add conditions (that would re-enable the sweep).
_note_requires: context_window=full comes from PR #54 (R2 full context). Launching before it is on the launched SHA fails at config load.
_note_model_params: Equal 64k output caps (max_tokens; max_completion_tokens for OpenAI and Kimi K3). Thinking on for all three. Opus 5.5: effort=xhigh, no sampling params, Message Batches API via the lockstep worker (worker_role=lockstep-worker; coordinator STALE_AFTER_SECONDS >= 12600). Kimi K3: always thinks, reasoning_effort=max (Moonshot's default, set explicitly for provenance), no thinking object or sampling params; plain worker on the sync API (Moonshot Batch support for kimi-k3 unverified). GPT-6 Astra: reasoning_effort=xhigh, flex tier, image_detail=high, plain worker (the OpenAI agent has no batch path). Spend caps are set per model and per modality, unlike the equal output caps: spend_cap_usd is a hard stop on that model's priced usage in its worker process (interface/agents/spend_cap.py), sized from _note_cost; it resets if the worker restarts, so pair each with a provider budget. context_window=full resends every prior decision frame each query (history capped by max_history_tokens), so per-episode input grows quadratically with steps: estimate cost before launch.
_note_launch: Launch with difficulty_max_static_score = 8000 (--difficulty-max-static-score 8000, fleet DIFFICULTY_MAX=8000), set for this panel: the largest static score is M10's, about 7,840. Stage 2 refuses the run if any selected maze scores above the cap. Stage 2 takes tens of minutes per maze on these 18x18 mechanics mazes: the calibration scores only its own maze. Run it locally (python -m scripts.run_pipeline); the Claude client then uses the synchronous API at standard price. The render block names mujoco3d, so launch_distributed.sh runs deploy/setup_mujoco3d.sh (OSMesa plus the mujoco3d extra) on every VM; a local run needs MUJOCO_GL=osmesa or egl.
_note_cache: Prompt caching on, as in 2D: the start map and every earlier frame, inventory and action sit in the cached prefix; the current frame, budget/stall lines and question come after the last breakpoint. Measured 2026-10-21 on r1_S4_10x10_dense_1 in 3D (first_person + start_map, 31 queries, solved): Opus 5.5 sync read 86% of its input from cache (93% by the last query), each query reading exactly what the previous one wrote; Kimi K3's two-query check read the 5,206-token prefix. Opus: Message Batches with batch_cache_ttl=1h on the fleet. GPT-6 Astra: enable_prompt_cache=true (explicit breakpoints). Kimi K3: prompt_cache_ttl=1h. See run_config.mechanics_15_2d.json's _note_cache.
